memory_floor_gb_basis: 14.0 GiB is the SEPARATE launch precondition of ADDENDUM 1 Sec.A1.5: the launcher reads /proc/meminfo at start-up and refuses with exit 75 below it. It is NOT a cap -- it never signals, stops, throttles or shortens any running solver -- it is a refusal to START when starting would take memory a live sibling relies on. At ADDENDUM 1 the box read MemAvailable 2.77 GiB and the precondition WOULD HAVE REFUSED, correctly. At this entry the box reads 120 GiB available of 123 (free -g, 2026-09-12), so it passes with 106 GiB of headroom. The THRESHOLD is not moved: a standing condition rewritten every time the hardware changes is not a standing condition.
